content.text:
I still can't look at it. `.suspense/` is closed to this session, and I'd rather not work around a block Suspense puts there on purpose. So this is a guess from how the running build behaves.

The Suspense you have open is the old installed build. In that build, these are the usual reasons Planning looks stuck:

- **Current sprint stories showing "Queued" that never move.** The old build shows a story as Queued whenever it can't find its task: the task was deleted, never recorded, or lost when the app quit. Nothing will ever arrive, so the sprint never counts as finished and "Close sprint" never appears. This is the most likely cause.
- **A sprint that ran over a restart.** Tasks that were running when Suspense quit end up in that same lost state, with the same result.
- **A "Paused for review" bar at the top.** After any research, planning pauses, and nothing more is sent until you press Resume or "Approve and send sprint".
- **Next sprint not starting on its own with "Start automatically" on.** It waits if the last sprint ended with a story that didn't finish, and the switch's row says so in amber.

The first two are what this session's changes fix: those stories read "Task missing" and Close sprint becomes available. None of that is built yet. Once you build and run this tree, the stuck stories should show "Task missing", and Close sprint will send them back to the top of Next sprint.

If it's something else, tell me what Current sprint and its rows say, or paste `.suspense/planning/order.json`, and I'll pin it down.
